name: vgs-bc-mcp
description: Bridge Claude Desktop to your Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central environment through Microsoft's official Business Central MCP server.
long_description: Resilient stdio MCP proxy that forwards tool calls from Claude Desktop to the Business Central MCP HTTP endpoint. Forked from microsoft/BCTech samples/BcMCPProxyPython with production fixes: interactive browser sign-in (device-code fallback), non-blocking tool discovery (no 30s first-call hang) that emits tools/list_changed, reconnect on transient httpx errors with exponential backoff, pre-emptive MSAL silent token refresh, surfacing of upstream errors that arrive masked as successful responses, retry with backoff on Business Central rate limits (429/503), Base64 encoding of non-ASCII company/configuration names (MCP SEP-2243), tool annotations (read-only vs destructive) so Claude can auto-approve reads, and pass-through of resources and prompts for BC v28 and v29 (2026 release wave 2). Interactive sign-in requires 'http://localhost' added to the Azure app registration under Authentication > Mobile and desktop applications. Maintained by Vangelder Solutions, an independent Microsoft partner; not affiliated with Microsoft or Anthropic. Tenant ID, client ID, environment, company and configuration name are configured at install time via the prompts below. Privacy policy: https://vangeldersolutions.github.io/bc-mcp-proxy/privacy/

tenant_id.title: Azure Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: The Directory (tenant) ID of the Azure Active Directory hosting your Business Central environment. Find it in the Azure portal under Microsoft Entra ID > Overview.

client_id.title: Azure Client ID
client_id.description: The Application (client) ID of the Azure App Registration you created for this proxy. The app must have the Dynamics 365 Business Central delegated permissions (Financials.ReadWrite.All, user_impersonation) and 'Allow public client flows' enabled.

environment.title: Business Central Environment
environment.description: The Business Central environment name (for example: Production, Sandbox, MyDevEnv). Must match the environment as it appears in the BC admin center.

company.title: Business Central Company
company.description: The exact company name within the environment (case-sensitive). Example: 'CRONUS USA' or 'My Company Ltd.'.

configuration_name.title: BC MCP Configuration Name
configuration_name.description: Optional name of a specific Business Central MCP configuration to forward as the ConfigurationName header. Leave empty if your environment doesn't use named configurations.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Verbosity of the proxy's own logging. One of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. INFO is recommended; switch to DEBUG only when troubleshooting.

base_url.title: Business Central MCP endpoint
base_url.description: Default is Microsoft's single MCP host for BC v28 and v29 (https://mcp.businesscentral.dynamics.com). Only for BC v27 and earlier set this to the legacy https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com — the proxy auto-switches the OAuth scope and request headers to match.

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: How to sign in on first use. 'auto' (recommended): open the browser for an interactive sign-in, automatically falling back to the device-code flow if no browser is available. 'interactive': browser only. 'device_code': skip the browser entirely (use on headless/server hosts). Interactive sign-in requires the Azure app registration to have 'http://localhost' added under Authentication > Mobile and desktop applications.

tools.name: bc_actions_search
tools.description: Search the Business Central actions (API pages and operations) available to the signed-in user. Read-only.

tools.name: bc_actions_describe
tools.description: Describe one Business Central action: its parameters, filters and the operations it allows. Read-only.

tools.name: bc_actions_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a Business Central action: read records, or create / update / delete / post when the MCP configuration allows writes. Treated as destructive.
